note: Deck bend joining -X <-> +Z, the same canonical orientation as the RoadBend tile. highway-kit is generated by tools/assets/highway_kit.py and authored in STUDS, so scale is 1.0 and every pos is studs. Origin = bottom centre of the cell at ground level; road surface 7.07 (= CityDressing highway.deckHeight), soffit 6.10 (contract floor 6.0), parapet top 7.87. The deck is 7.14 wide: it cantilevers 0.07 past the cell on its free edges - testfit reports that as exceeding the 7x7 footprint, it is the fascia overhang and is deliberate - and stops at exactly 3.5 on any edge that butts a neighbouring cell. The parapet wraps the two closed edges (+X and -Z); the lane lines curve on a 3.5 radius about the inner corner so a straight's markings run into the bend without a jump.
